title: Lewandowski: robbed by a cancellation, then by Messi
checked: 2019-20: 55 goals (34 Bundesliga, 6 DFB-Pokal, 15 UCL), treble, top scorer in the Bundesliga and the UCL (Bundesliga.com, SoccerLaduma, Wikipedia BL 2019-20). Ballon d'Or 2020 cancelled by France Football on 20 July 2020, 'lack of sufficient fair conditions' (Topend, India TV, BusinessWorld). Bayern 8-2 Barcelona, 14 Aug 2020, Lisbon, Lewandowski scored the sixth (FourFourTwo, FC Bayern). The Best FIFA Men's Player 2020 (CBS, ESPN) and 2021 (ESPN 'twice'). 41st Bundesliga goal, 90', 22 May 2021 v Augsburg, Sane's shot saved by Gikiewicz and Lewandowski first to the rebound, beating Gerd Muller's 40 from 1971-72 (Fox/AP, FC Bayern, TNT). 2021 vote Messi 613, Lewandowski 580, Jorginho 460 (Topend, TNT); Messi on stage: 'you deserve your Ballon d'Or' (SI, Stadium Astro); the first Striker of the Year award (TNT/Eurosport, TBS). Gameplay: the 41st goal as Sane's saved shot then the finish, gamecap specs/rob-lewandowski-2020.json; Augsburg's kit assumed.

lines.text: Fifty-five goals. The treble. FIFA's best player in the world. And still no Ballon d'Or.
lines.say: Fifty five goals. The treble. FIFA's best player in the world. And still no Balon Dor.

lines.text: 2019-20. Thirty-four in the league, six in the cup, fifteen in the Champions League.

scene.headline: No Ballon d'Or in 2020
scene.standfirst: France Football cancels its award for the first time, saying a season broken up by Covid did not give fair conditions.

lines.text: So he kept going. In Lisbon, Bayern beat Barcelona eight-two. He scored one of them.

lines.text: Then PSG in the final. The treble. Top scorer in Germany, and in Europe.

lines.text: In December, FIFA named him the best player in the world. The Ballon d'Or had no winner at all.

lines.text: Next season, he went after Gerd Müller's record. Forty league goals, set in 1972.
